CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._export_profile_name(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(p.full_name, p.phone, p.email, u.email)
  FROM profiles p
  LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = p.id
  WHERE p.id = p_user_id
  LIMIT 1;
$function$
